product.name: Alerts & Waitlists
product.description: Back-in-stock, price-drop, availability and custom alerts with waitlists: a drop-in or headless "Notify me" form, triggers from inventory, price and custom events, delivery through the merchant's own messaging provider with caps, quiet hours and batching — all data in the merchant's own database.

elements.name: Triggers
elements.description: What fires alerts: inventory.changed@1, price.changed@1 and custom.* events from the Event Hub, POST /v1/triggers, batches and CSV imports. Tracks each target's stock (per location) and price, trusts stock and price only from the merchant's servers, and claims waiters exactly once per change.

elements.name: Alert types
elements.description: Back-in-stock, price-drop (minimum drop in percent / amount, shopper target price), availability / slot waitlists notified by free capacity, and merchant-defined custom types fired by custom.* events with rules@1 conditions; expiry and retention.

elements.name: Notify-me capture
elements.description: The "Notify me" form — drop-in, headless or API: the signed-in customer's own address (bring-your-own identity) or a typed e-mail / E.164 phone, consent text, double opt-in, per-IP and per-contact limits.

elements.name: Dispatch
elements.description: Delivery through the merchant's own messaging connector: templates per type, channel and language, frequency caps per contact, quiet hours in the website's time zone, batching into digests, retries with backoff, and claim-before-send so no message is sent twice across instances.

elements.name: Waitlist priority
elements.description: Waitlist order — first come first told, or by a tier claim of the customer's own login token — with positions for shoppers and an ordered waitlist for the merchant.

elements.name: Unsubscribe
elements.description: Signed unsubscribe links in every message, a hosted confirm page (link previews and scanners never unsubscribe), RFC 8058 one-click for e-mail, per-alert or per-contact scope and a suppression list.

elements.name: Analytics
elements.description: Subscriptions by type and status, messages by channel and status, notified / unsubscribe / delivery rates and a daily series.

plans.name: Starter
plans.description: Back-in-stock and price-drop alerts with the Notify-me form, event / API / CSV triggers, delivery and unsubscribe; analytics as an add-on.

plans.name: Pro
plans.description: Everything, including waitlist priority by customer tier and analytics; 2 000 sends per hour included.
